scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Huh. So that giant
air pouch can make
people float in midair?
Would filling my tummy
with air work the same way?
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
哼。所以那个巨大的
气囊可以让人们
漂浮在半空中吗？
如果往我肚子里
灌满空气，效果也会一样吗？

scripts.text:
[Emily]
I feel so blessed to
live in this quant, little
town. It's so beautiful, and
everyone here is so nice~
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
我觉得能生活在这个
宁静的小镇真是太幸福了。
这里非常美丽，而且
这里的每个人都非常友善~

scripts.text:
[Emily]
For some reason, my older
sister wants to move out of
Hugel as soon as she can. She
Says that she's getting crept
out by the people that live here.
Don't you think that sounds weird?
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
不知出于什么原因，我姐姐
想尽快搬出毁葛。她说
这里的人让她感到毛骨悚然。
你不觉得这听起来很奇怪吗？

scripts.text:
[Kayplas]
Ooh, I really want to
have that red bottle.
I should ask my mom
to buy me one. It doesn't
look too expensive, does it?
scripts.translation:
[凯普拉斯]
噢，我真的很想要
那个红色的瓶子。
我应该叫我妈妈
给我买一个。它看起来
不怎么贵，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
Hugel is a pretty
small, homely village.
Everyone knows everyone,
everybody knows what
everybody else is doing.
It's so suffocating!
scripts.translation:
[丽莎]
毁葛是一个非常
小巧、温馨的村庄。
每个人都互相认识，
每个人都知道别人
在做什么。真是让人
感到窒息！

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
There's no privacy in
small towns. Someday,
I wanna go out and
live in the big city~
scripts.translation:
[丽莎]
小镇里根本没有隐私。
总有一天，我想去
大城市生活~

scripts.text:
[Old Nikki]
You must not be from
around here. Ah, you're
an adventurer, right? Do
you know how I could tell?
scripts.translation:
[老 尼基]
你一定不是这附近的人。
啊，你是冒险者，对吧？
你知道我是怎么看出来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Nikki]
It's because everyone
who's lived here starts
to look alike after a while.
And you certainly don't look
as old as us. Well, have
a nice day, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[老 尼基]
因为住在这里的人
久而久之都会长得一模一样。
而你看起来肯定不像
我们这么老。好了，祝你
今天愉快，冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Marius]
Yes, I'm an old man, but
I can lick a whippersnapper
like you any day of the week!
You know, Hugel's got a longer
life expectancy than all the other towns. You wanna know why?
scripts.translation:
[马里乌斯]
没错，我虽然是个老头，
但我随时都能教训你这种
毛头小子！你知道吗，毁葛的
平均寿命比其他城镇都要长。
你想知道为什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Marius]
It's because the old
coots in this town refuse
to just lay down and die!
Now, c'mon! Lemme show
you how strong I am! Let's
wrestle or something, kid~
scripts.translation:
[马里乌斯]
那是因为这个镇上的
老家伙们都不肯
就这么躺下等死！
来吧！让我让你看看
我有多强壮！来，跟老头子
摔跤什么的，小子~

scripts.text:
[Chris]
You know, the people don't
fight harmful monsters, they
just protect themselves by
equipping armor. That's
just the way they are.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
你知道吗，这里的人们
并不去对抗有害的怪物，
他们只是通过装备护甲
来保护自己。他们就是
这种性格。

scripts.text:
[Chris]
If you want to buy
some nicer armors,
then I suggest buying
some in a bigger city.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
如果你想买一些
更好的护甲，我建议
去更大的城市购买。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Welcome to the party supplies
shop!
Why don't you enjoy some
spectacular fireworks with your
friends?
We can provide you with 5 of them
at 500 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
欢迎光临派对用品店！
为什么不和你的朋友们
一起享受一下精彩的
烟花呢？
我们可以为你提供5个，
价格是500 泽尼。

scripts.text: Buy
scripts.translation: 购买

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
I am sorry, but you don't have
enough money~
scripts.translation:
[店主]
很抱歉，你的钱不够~

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Here you go!
Have fun with them!
scripts.translation:
[店主]
给你！
玩得开心点！

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Thank you, please come again.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
谢谢，欢迎下次光临。

scripts.text:
[Luda]
Welcome to the
Shrine Expedition Office.
I'm Luda, a part-time
assistant. My job is to
keep this office neat and
clean, but look at this place!
scripts.translation:
[露达]
欢迎来到
神龛远征办公室。
我是露达，一名兼职
助手。我的工作是保持
办公室整洁干净，但你看看
这地方！

scripts.text:
[Luda]
Still, I think I can
handle this difficult task~
This room is the office for
the Schwarzwald Republic team,
and the other is for the Rune-
Midgarts Kingdom team.
scripts.translation:
[露达]
不过，我想我还是能
应付这项艰巨的任务的~
这间房间是修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德
共和国队的办公室，另一间
则是鲁尼米德加茨王国的办公室。

scripts.text:
[Luda]
I have to clean both rooms,
so they keep me pretty busy.
Why don't you volunteer for
their expedition? I know they
can't really pay you, but it's
a great chance to explore~
scripts.translation:
[露达]
我必须把两间房间都打扫干净，
所以一直很忙。你为什么不
自愿参加他们的远征呢？我知道
他们没法给你多少报酬，但这是一个
探索世界的绝佳机会~

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis part-timer is
completely engrossed
in his task of organizing
files and books.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这个兼职人员正
全神贯注地忙着
整理文件和书籍。^000000
